title: [BORDERLINE] Akhetonics (Germany) — optical computing with quantum mode
description:
**Company:** Akhetonics
**Website:** https://www.akhetonics.com
**Country:** Germany (Berlin)
**Founded:** 2021
**Funding:** €6M seed (November 2024, Matterwave Ventures)

**Issue:** Akhetonics builds an all-optical XPU (cross-domain processor) that operates entirely in the photonic domain. Quantum computing is one operating mode of the XPU (via the EU SPOC project on scalable CV quantum computing with Fraunhofer IZM), but the primary product is optical computing — not quantum.

**Activity signal:** LASER World of Photonics exhibitor June 2025; active website.
